page.overview:
Who is Acrobat (Spider-Squad)?

The Acrobat was a member of the mercenary group known as the Spider Squad. The Acrobat was given a spider themed exoskeleton that gave him uncanny agility. The Acrobat the others worked for film producer Anton DeLionatus and fought Spider Man.
